item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 02/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Under the influence of the dry monsoon, it will be generally fine over the coast of southern China during the weekend and early next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. The monsoon is expected to moderate gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be cloudier over the region.
